note: Bridger-Teton NF campground on the Big Spring Scenic Backway (Hams Fork Road, FR 10062), about 38 miles north of Kemmerer: sites in lodgepole on both sides of the road, with the Hams Fork River across the meadow to the west. Summer trash service. No cell service. --Claude
